snippet.title: Game Jam Now Winter 2025
snippet.description:
With only a journal in hand, you sail off in search of undiscovered wonders.
You are off to study and observe the unique creatures of an idyllic island!

There are placid, herbivorous, tapir-bugs. Territorial grumpy turtle-goats who enjoy headbutting, and possibly a secretive creature by the top of the mountain…

Your task is to observe each creatures:

Social Behaviour
Diet
Temperament
